extDescription.message: Read Instagram voice messages as text. Transcribed privately on your device with Whisper — no audio ever leaves your browser.

errAudioMissing.message: Audio not found. Reload the page (F5) and open the conversation again.

errAudioHttp.message: Could not download the audio (HTTP $1). Reload the page and try again.

model_fast_desc.message: Whisper small · about 3× faster · for slower computers

popupSubtitle.message: Speech-to-text runs entirely on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

languageHint.message: Choosing the language skips detection and avoids mistakes on very short messages.

confirmDelete.message: Delete the downloaded $1 model? It will be downloaded again if you use it.

noteSaved.message: Saved. Applies to the next transcription.
